$comment: Model routing reference. Not merged into openclaw.json — used by setup-crons.sh and as documentation for the recommended model strategy. Prefer subscription models (Gemini CLI OAuth, OpenAI Codex OAuth) over API-billed models (Anthropic) to control costs.

main_chat.rationale: Fast, cheap, good enough for general conversation and planning. Subscription via google-gemini-cli OAuth.

coding.rationale: Strong coding model on subscription billing. Use /model gpt-5.4 in a Coding topic, or delegate to sub-agent.

deep_research.rationale: Strong reasoning. Subscription via Codex OAuth.

crons_lightweight.rationale: Nightly ops crons are lightweight checks. No need for frontier models.

crons_heavy.rationale: Memory synthesis and doc drift benefit from stronger reasoning. Subscription via Codex OAuth.

precision.rationale: Best-in-class reasoning (91% GPQA Diamond, 75% ARC-AGI-2). API-billed — use only for deep reasoning tasks where Codex falls short. Sonnet is not worth the API cost over Codex.

local_fallback.rationale: Free, runs on host Metal GPU. Last resort when hosted providers are down. No web tools allowed.
